segments.name: Precision medicine
segments.description: Clinical-stage precision medicine pharmaceutical company developing the anti-cancer drug stenoparib and its DRP companion diagnostic for ovarian cancer patients.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reporting segment, reflecting our sole focus in developing a treatment for ovarian cancer.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for DRP gene expression signature services, plus up-front license fees, milestone payments and royalties under collaboration and out-licensing agreements.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenue primarily consists of services performed using our novel DRP platform.

changes.text: In 2024, the company terminated all other assets, including dovitinib, Irofulven and LiPlaCis, to focus solely on stenoparib.
changes.evidence: All other assets including dovitinib, Irofulven and LiPlaCis, were terminated and are no longer part of our portfolio.

changes.text: In 2024, Novartis terminated the license agreement, and the company ceased all development and commercialization activities with respect to all licensed products.
changes.evidence: On January 26, 2024, the Company received a termination notice from Novartis due to a material breach of the Original Agreement.
